summary: Request for tamper-evident audit-access history, cross-service lineage, and legal-hold export for tenant
description:
Issue summary:
Customer Acme HealthTech (enterprise) requests a cryptographically verifiable export of audit-access history and event lineage for tenant T-0421 covering 2026-01-01 to 2026-02-28. They require per-event chain-of-custody showing which Redwood principal (user/service account) accessed, viewed, or exported tenant audit records, plus a tamper-evident manifest (signed checkpoint) and a legal-hold flag applied to the dataset.

Why unique/different from other requests: customer explicitly needs cross-service correlation (api-gateway request IDs, console session IDs, and audit-service event IDs) mapped together and a fallback delivery (S3 presigned URL and SFTP) with a failover plan. They also want an explanation of data retention enforcement and confirmation that legal-hold prevents automated purging across Dedicated/private backends.
impact: Customer requires the package for an upcoming regulatory investigation; delay beyond SLA may escalate to compliance/legal. Failure to prove access lineage could lead to customer escalation.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer used Console > Tenant Settings > Audit > Export to request an audit bundle on 2026-03-02 (UI request id: ui-7f3a2b).
2) Export reported as 'Completed' in console at 2026-03-02T14:23:11Z but customer says files do not contain access-history bindings (they contain only action logs).
3) Customer attempted to request same range via API /v1/audit/exports with tenant_id T-0421 and received HTTP 202 with job_id export-9c4d; job finished but listing shows export manifest without signed checkpoint header.
4) Customer requests canonical export with signed manifest and event lineage mapping of request_id -> api_gateway_id -> session_id -> audit_event_id for each access event.
attached_log_snippets:
Customer-provided snippets:
- UI request id: ui-7f3a2b (2026-03-02T14:22:58Z)
- API job id: export-9c4d (2026-03-02T14:23:03Z)
- Example missing mapping: audit_event_id ae-33021 shows 'downloaded: true' but no session_id or api_gateway_id field in exported JSON
Support-side logs pulled (subset):
- audit-service: INFO export job export-9c4d completed, manifest=man-20260302-9c4d, signed=false
- sftp-uploader: WARN sftp fallback not configured for tenant T-0421
- auth: INFO session session-22b4 created for user:d.rodriguez@acmehealth at 2026-02-15T09:11:02Z
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: export pipeline is emitting action logs but the lineage enrichment step (which joins api-gateway and console telemetry to audit events) did not run for this historical range due to a backfill job failure in mid-February. Evidence: export manifest flagged 'signed=false' and enrichment worker logs show RetryExceeded for backfill-run-20260214.
SRE findings so far:
- Found a transient index-mapping change in enrichment pipeline on 2026-02-14 that caused a subset of session_id->event_id joins to be skipped.
- The signing microservice (signer) was redeployed 2026-02-13 and a config flag ENABLE_EXPORT_SIGNING was false in the deployment for the node that processed export-9c4d.
- No indication that customer data was exfiltrated; access events exist in raw stores but are missing cross-reference fields in the produced bundle.
next_steps:
1) Schedule a controlled re-run/backfill of lineage enrichment for tenant T-0421 covering 2026-01-01..2026-02-28 with high priority. Owner: Marcus Chen. ETA: 2026-03-12.
2) Produce a new export bundle with:
   - tamper-evident signed manifest (ed25519)
   - per-event lineage mapping fields (api_gateway_id, console_session_id, principal_id)
   - checksums per file and an overall manifest hash
3) Provide delivery options: S3 presigned link (7-day TTL) and password-protected SFTP (rotate credential and provide transfer confirmation).
4) Apply a temporary customer-level legal-hold marker to prevent purge while investigation open.
5) Provide an explanation of retention/legal-hold behavior across Dedicated/Private if applicable.
resolution: Work in progress: backfill scheduled 2026-03-12; signer config fixed 2026-03-11 to set ENABLE_EXPORT_SIGNING=true for export workers. Expected deliverable: signed export bundle and lineage map delivered via S3 presigned URL and optional SFTP by 2026-03-12 end of day UTC. Follow-up: written statement confirming legal-hold prevents TTL-based purges (for Hosted and Dedicated control planes) and instructions for Private on-prem legal-hold operator steps.
final_resolution_notes: Pending: actual export delivery and customer verification required before closing. If delivered, will append checksum, manifest signature, and delivery confirmation.
